test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Some things are meant to be, and death is ______ for humans.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"natural"** means existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind. (प्राकृतिक)

 
 
• **Example: **The natural beauty of the mountains left us speechless.
 
 
 
• Similarly, the context tells us that death is a normal part of life for humans, and certain things are meant to be. 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Edible **(खाने योग्य): Fit to be eaten.

 
 
• **Example:** Not all mushrooms are edible; some are poisonous.
 
 
 
• **Spiral **(सर्पिल): Winding in a continuous and gradually widening (or tightening) curve.
 
 
• **Example: **The staircase spirals up to the top floor of the building.
 
 
 
• **Viral** (वायरल): Relating to or involving a virus; also, something that quickly becomes very popular on the internet.
 
 
• **Example:** The video went viral within hours of being posted online.
